items.name: b11861
items.body:
<details open>

minimax-m3 : forward quant scales to the graph (fixes #31063) (#31097)

The generic scale pass in llama-model.cpp loads the per-expert
NVFP4 scale2 tensors (ffn_{up,gate,down}_exps_s) and the per-tensor
MXFP8 scales for the dense FFN and the shared expert, but
minimax-m3.cpp never forwarded any of them to the graph.

build_moe_ffn() defaults these to nullptr, so build_lora_mm_id()
skipped its w_s branch entirely and the routed-expert weights came
out global_scale times too large, swamping the residual (reported
G ~= 15123 for M3.1 Flash) and producing token soup.

Forward all scale tensors at the three call sites, matching the
pattern used by flint and the other NVFP4-capable MoE models.

Co-authored-by: origin-labs-ai <origin-labs-ai@users.noreply.github.com>

</details>

<details open>

llama : deny -sm tensor for arches with moe amax rescaling (#31081)

The amax POOL_1D reduction spans the whole matmul row, so a device cannot
compute it from an axis-0 split. The Meta split-state case reported
MIRRORED, which gives each device a partial max of its own slice. Drop
that case and deny -sm tensor for the arches which build the amax graph,
see [TAG_MOE_AMAX_SCALE].

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (MacBook, M5 Max, 128GB)
